test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Sales of 5 cars A, B, C, D and E is compared. Sales of no two cars is same. Sales of B is less than only A. Sales of D is less than C but more than E. If sales of C is 300 , then what is the possible value of sales of A?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Sales are all different
 
• B is less than only A → A is highest, B is second highest
 
• D E → C > D > E
 
• C = 300

So order becomes:

A > B > C > D > E

Since C = 300,
B must be greater than 300, and A must be greater than B

So A must be greater than 300.

Hence, any value greater than 300 is possible.

As per given options, only 310 is greater than 300.

Thus, if sales of C is 300 , the possible value of sales of A is 310.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
